matched_evidence: The parish identifies a separate tall belfry north of the church.
The independent May/June 2016 frontal photographs show the belfry on the right of the pointed front entrance. The river photographs place the belfry on the northeast side of the main dome.
OpenStreetMap also locates a separate tower point just outside the named chapel building polygon, edgelong roof buildings and canal are not site boundaries.

tower.matching_inference: Nearby position and historical imagery are consistent with the belfry described by the parish. OSM does not identify the point by name.

exterior_orientation: The gated forecourt is northeast of the chapel. The opposite-bank view looks northwest. The NE-front short wall has an approximate outward normal of 55 degrees. The measured tower point and the crossing-road vs riverside images support this identification. No surveyed doorway azimuth is available.
